newsitem.title: USA: Clinton heading to New York to prepare for debate.
newsitem.headline: Clinton heading to New York to prepare for debate.

text.p: President Clinton will travel to Chautauqua, New York, for three days late next week to prepare for the Oct. 6 presidential debate in Hartford, Connecticut, the Clinton/Gore campaign said Sunday.

Clinton, who will host a summit meeting between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in the first half of the week, will spend Thursday through Saturday at the Lake Chautauqua Institute.
Republican challenger Bob Dole wound up a four-day stay in Florida on Sunday after cramming for the two debates with Clinton, the second of which will be a town hall meeting in San Diego on Oct. 16.
